This document out lines the testing procedure P1, to be 
 performed on an annually bases as indicated Y1 in the title block

The measured voltage is coupled via an intermediate PT, which provides DC 
 isolation from the primary circuit and rectifiers to one or two electronic 
 triggers which upon picking up exit electronic timing elements

The output of each relay is contactors, and there are signal lambs for both 
 pick-up and tripping, which remain illuminated until reset. the input 
 circuitry of the relay is arranged to prevent interference on the input leads 
 from entering the measuring system The output contact of the under voltage is 
 energized when the input voltage is below setting tripping contact made.

This document initiated by eng. Ayman Mohamed Mohamed, tested by eng. Maher 
 Abdel Gwad Salem, accepted by eng. Mohamed Elsayed Ahmed, and approved by 
 general manger eng. Mohamed Salah Eldin Abdel Ghafar. This document revised by 
 eng. Nageh Soliman Shousha: CEPC quality control director, and certified by 
 eng. Afaf Ebrahim El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's Head Sector and 
 MPIS coordinator

Introduction
This document out lines the testing procedure P1, to be 
 performed on an annually bases as indicated Y1 in the title block
The measured voltage is coupled via an intermediate PT, which provides DC 
 isolation from the primary circuit and rectifiers to one or two electronic 
 triggers which upon picking up exit electronic timing elements
The output of each relay is contactors, and there are signal lambs for both 
 pick-up and tripping, which remain illuminated until reset. the input 
 circuitry of the relay is arranged to prevent interference on the input leads 
 from entering the measuring system The output contact of the under voltage is 
 energized when the input voltage is below setting tripping contact made.
This document initiated by eng. Ayman Mohamed Mohamed, tested by eng. Maher 
 Abdel Gwad Salem, accepted by eng. Mohamed Elsayed Ahmed, and approved by 
 general manger eng. Mohamed Salah Eldin Abdel Ghafar. This document revised by

Safety Precaution
A
 work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category
Wear
 your safety helmet & safety shoes.
Safety
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Gas turbine out off service.
Tools and Equipment
Injection device model Manta MTS-1710.
Test Leads.
Screws.
Power source 220 volt for injection device
Work to be carried out
The main transformer off.
Remove the terminals F1 (29, 30)
Connect the relay test unit to a power source.
Connect the Injection device test leads between 
 the voltage terminals at F1 (29, 30) as shown in figure (1).
Increase the injected voltage gradually to the 
 nominal voltage then decrease the voltage gradually until the relay it 
 pick-up.
Record this voltage on the test sheet.
Compare the result with final setting and 
 measurement.
Turn off the injection device.
Connect the time terminal for the injection 
 device to terminal F3 (17; 18) and inject the voltage which appeared in step 6 
 suddenly.
Record the time on the test sheet.
Compare the result 
 with final setting and measurement.
